name: Memcached
description: The Memcached app is a unified logs and metrics app that helps you monitor the availability, performance, health and resource utilization of your Memcached clusters. Preconfigured dashboards provide insight into uptime, operational metrics, cache performance, resource utilization, errors, warnings and commands executed.

children.name: Logs
children.description: This folder contains log based dashboards for Memcached

children.name: Memcached - Logs
children.description: This dashboard helps you quickly analyze your Memcached error logs, commands executed, and objects stored.
children.title: Memcached - Logs

queries.queryString:
db_cluster=* db_cluster={{db_cluster}} db_system=memcached memcached "Client using the" | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as memcached_log_message
| parse regex field=memcached_log_message "(?<pid>\d+): Client using the (?<protocol>\w+) protocol"
| count as count by protocol
| sort by count

db_cluster=* db_cluster={{db_cluster}} db_system=memcached memcached "<" ( TOUCH or GET or STATS or ADD or SET or REPLACE) | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as memcached_log_message
| parse regex field=memcached_log_message "<(?<pid>\d+) (?<cmd>\w+)*"
| toUpperCase(cmd) as cmd
| where cmd matches "TOUCH" or cmd matches "GET" or cmd matches "STATS" or cmd matches "ADD" or cmd matches "SET" or cmd matches "REPLACE"
| count by cmd

db_cluster=* db_cluster={{db_cluster}} db_system=memcached memcached "<" ( TOUCH or GET or STATS or ADD or SET or REPLACE) | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as memcached_log_message
| parse regex field=memcached_log_message "<(?<pid>\d+) (?<cmd>\w+)*"
| toUpperCase(cmd) as cmd
| where cmd matches "TOUCH" or cmd matches "GET" or cmd matches "STATS" or cmd matches "ADD" or cmd matches "SET" or cmd matches "REPLACE"
| if(cmd matches "TOUCH",1,0) as TOUCH
| if(cmd matches "GET",1,0) as GET
| if(cmd matches "STATS",1,0) as STATS
| if(cmd matches "ADD",1,0) as ADD
| if(cmd matches "SET",1,0) as SET
| if(cmd matches "REPLACE",1,0) as REPLACE
| timeslice by 1h 
| sum (TOUCH) as TOUCH,  sum (GET) as GET, sum (STATS) as STATS, sum (ADD) as ADD, sum (SET) as SET, sum (REPLACE) as REPLACE by _timeslice

db_cluster=* db_cluster={{db_cluster}} db_system=memcached memcached ">" ERROR | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as memcached_log_message
| parse regex field=memcached_log_message ">(?<pid>\d+) (?<msg>.+)"
| if(msg matches "ERROR",1,0) as ERROR
| timeslice by 1s
| count as count by _timeslice,msg
| fields _timeslice,msg
| limit 10

db_cluster=* db_cluster={{db_cluster}} db_system=memcached memcached ">" ERROR | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as memcached_log_message
| parse regex field=memcached_log_message ">(?<pid>\d+) (?<msg>\w+)"
| if(msg matches "ERROR",1,0) as ERROR
| timeslice by 15m
| count as count by _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice(15m)

db_cluster=* db_cluster={{db_cluster}} db_system=memcached memcached | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as memcached_log_message
| parse regex field=memcached_log_message ">(?<pid>\d+) (?<msg>\w+)" nodrop
| parse regex field=memcached_log_message "<(?<pid>\d+) (?<msg>\w+)"
| limit 10000
| logreduce by msg | _count as count | sort by count
| fields msg, signature, count

db_cluster=* db_cluster={{db_cluster}} db_system=memcached memcached ">" STORED | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as memcached_log_message
| parse regex field=memcached_log_message ">(?<pid>\d+) (?<cmd>\w+)"
| if(cmd matches "STORED",1,0) as STORED
| timeslice by 1h 
| sum(STORED) as STORED by _timeslice
